# generate-graphql — GraphQL SDL Schema Generation Skill

Generate GraphQL Schema Definition Language (SDL) files from Linear issue
requirements using the `GraphQLGenerator` class. Produce a complete type system
with Relay-compatible connections, typed mutations, subscriptions, and
field-level authorization directives.

## Generator Interface

```
Module  : src/uptempo/schema/graphql.py  (to be implemented)
Class   : GraphQLGenerator(SchemaGenerator)
Methods :
  generate(issue: Issue, workspace: Path) -> list[Path]
  validate(files: list[Path]) -> list[str]
Base    : src/uptempo/schema/base.py — SchemaGenerator
```

## Input

| Field | Source | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `issue.identifier` | Linear | Issue ID (e.g., `UPT-105`) — embedded in header comment |
| `issue.title` | Linear | Short summary — becomes schema title seed |
| `issue.description` | Linear | Full requirements — parse for types, queries, mutations |
| `workspace` | Orchestrator | Absolute path to `./workspaces/{issue_id}/` |

## Output

```
{workspace}/
└── graphql/
    ├── schema.graphql           # Root schema: Query, Mutation, Subscription
    ├── types/
    │   ├── {entity}.graphql     # Object types (User, Order, Product…)
    │   └── scalars.graphql      # Custom scalar definitions
    ├── inputs/
    │   └── {mutation}.graphql   # Mutation input/payload types
    ├── connections/
    │   └── {entity}.graphql     # Relay connection/edge types
    └── directives/
        └── auth.graphql         # Custom directive definitions
```

All `.graphql` files include the standard header:

```graphql
# Generated by Uptempo for UPT-105: E-Commerce Product Catalog API
```

## Procedure

### Step 1 — Parse Requirements

1. Extract domain entities from `issue.description` (e.g., "user", "order", "product").
2. Identify query patterns: single entity, list/connection, search, nested lookups.
3. Identify mutations: create, update, delete, state transitions, bulk operations.
4. Detect subscription needs: real-time events, status changes, notifications.
5. Note access control requirements: roles, field-level auth, public vs private fields.
6. Check for federation hints: service boundaries, `@key` fields, external references.

### Step 2 — Initialize Workspace

```python
from uptempo.schema.graphql import GraphQLGenerator

generator = GraphQLGenerator()
out_dir = workspace / "graphql"
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

### Step 3 — Define Root Schema

```graphql
# schema.graphql
schema {
  query: Query
  mutation: Mutation
  subscription: Subscription
}

type Query {
  node(id: ID!): Node
}

type Mutation

type Subscription
```

### Step 4 — Generate Core Interfaces and Scalars

Always include the Node interface for Relay compliance:

```graphql
# types/scalars.graphql
scalar DateTime
scalar URL
scalar EmailAddress
scalar JSON
scalar Cursor

interface Node {
  id: ID!
}
```

### Step 5 — Generate Entity Types

Map each domain entity to a GraphQL Object type implementing `Node`:

```graphql
# types/order.graphql
type Order implements Node {
  id: ID!
  status: OrderStatus!
  customer: User!
  items: [OrderItem!]!
  totalCents: Int!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  CONFIRMED
  SHIPPED
  DELIVERED
  CANCELLED
}

type OrderItem {
  id: ID!
  product: Product!
  quantity: Int!
  priceCents: Int!
}
```

Rules:
- All entities implement `Node` with globally unique `id: ID!`.
- Non-null by default for required fields — use `!` suffix.
- Enum values: `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`.
- Use Interfaces for shared field sets across types.
- Use Unions for polymorphic return types.
- Monetary values: integer cents, never floating point.

### Step 6 — Generate Relay Connection Types

Wrap all list fields with the Connection pattern:

```graphql
# connections/order.graphql
type OrderConnection {
  edges: [OrderEdge!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
  totalCount: Int!
}

type OrderEdge {
  cursor: String!
  node: Order!
}

type PageInfo {
  hasNextPage: Boolean!
  hasPreviousPage: Boolean!
  startCursor: String
  endCursor: String
}
```

Add connection fields to Query root:

```graphql
extend type Query {
  order(id: ID!): Order
  orders(
    first: Int
    after: String
    last: Int
    before: String
    filter: OrderFilterInput
    orderBy: OrderOrderByInput
  ): OrderConnection!
}
```

### Step 7 — Generate Mutation Input/Payload Types

Follow the pattern: dedicated Input type → dedicated Payload type with `errors`:

```graphql
# inputs/create-order.graphql
input CreateOrderInput {
  clientMutationId: String
  customerId: ID!
  items: [OrderItemInput!]!
}

input OrderItemInput {
  productId: ID!
  quantity: Int!
}

type CreateOrderPayload {
  clientMutationId: String
  order: Order
  errors: [UserError!]!
}

type UserError {
  field: [String!]
  message: String!
  code: ErrorCode!
}

enum ErrorCode {
  INVALID_INPUT
  NOT_FOUND
  UNAUTHORIZED
  CONFLICT
  INTERNAL
}
```

Wire mutations into root:

```graphql
extend type Mutation {
  createOrder(input: CreateOrderInput!): CreateOrderPayload!
  updateOrder(input: UpdateOrderInput!): UpdateOrderPayload!
  deleteOrder(input: DeleteOrderInput!): DeleteOrderPayload!
}
```

### Step 8 — Generate Subscriptions

Map real-time events to Subscription fields:

```graphql
extend type Subscription {
  orderStatusChanged(orderId: ID!): OrderStatusEvent!
  newNotification(userId: ID!): Notification!
}

type OrderStatusEvent {
  order: Order!
  previousStatus: OrderStatus!
  newStatus: OrderStatus!
  changedAt: DateTime!
}
```

### Step 9 — Generate Custom Directives

Define authorization and caching directives:

```graphql
# directives/auth.graphql
directive @auth(requires: Role!) on FIELD_DEFINITION | OBJECT
directive @cacheControl(
  maxAge: Int
  scope: CacheControlScope
) on FIELD_DEFINITION | OBJECT
directive @deprecated(reason: String) on FIELD_DEFINITION | ENUM_VALUE

enum Role {
  PUBLIC
  USER
  ADMIN
  SYSTEM
}

enum CacheControlScope {
  PUBLIC
  PRIVATE
}
```

Apply directives to fields:

```graphql
type Order implements Node {
  id: ID!
  status: OrderStatus!
  customer: User! @auth(requires: USER)
  internalNotes: String @auth(requires: ADMIN)
  items: [OrderItem!]! @cacheControl(maxAge: 60, scope: PRIVATE)
}
```

### Step 10 — Add DataLoader Hints

Annotate fields prone to N+1 queries with comments:

```graphql
type Order implements Node {
  id: ID!
  # @dataloader: batchUsersByIds — load customer in batch
  customer: User!
  # @dataloader: batchProductsByIds — load products in batch
  items: [OrderItem!]!
}
```

### Step 11 — Write Files

```python
files = generator.generate(issue, workspace)
```

### Step 12 — Validate

```python
errors = generator.validate(files)
# Runs graphql-js validate
```

## Output Template

Minimal valid schema with one entity:

```graphql
# Generated by Uptempo for UPT-105: E-Commerce Product Catalog API

# --- schema.graphql ---
schema {
  query: Query
  mutation: Mutation
  subscription: Subscription
}

scalar DateTime
scalar Cursor

interface Node {
  id: ID!
}

type PageInfo {
  hasNextPage: Boolean!
  hasPreviousPage: Boolean!
  startCursor: String
  endCursor: String
}

type UserError {
  field: [String!]
  message: String!
  code: ErrorCode!
}

enum ErrorCode {
  INVALID_INPUT
  NOT_FOUND
  UNAUTHORIZED
  CONFLICT
  INTERNAL
}

directive @auth(requires: Role!) on FIELD_DEFINITION | OBJECT
enum Role { PUBLIC USER ADMIN SYSTEM }

# --- types/product.graphql ---
type Product implements Node {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  description: String
  priceCents: Int!
  category: ProductCategory!
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

enum ProductCategory {
  ELECTRONICS
  CLOTHING
  FOOD
  OTHER
}

# --- connections/product.graphql ---
type ProductConnection {
  edges: [ProductEdge!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
  totalCount: Int!
}

type ProductEdge {
  cursor: String!
  node: Product!
}

type Query {
  node(id: ID!): Node
  product(id: ID!): Product
  products(
    first: Int
    after: String
    last: Int
    before: String
  ): ProductConnection!
}

# --- inputs/create-product.graphql ---
input CreateProductInput {
  clientMutationId: String
  name: String!
  description: String
  priceCents: Int!
  category: ProductCategory!
}

type CreateProductPayload {
  clientMutationId: String
  product: Product
  errors: [UserError!]!
}

type Mutation {
  createProduct(input: CreateProductInput!): CreateProductPayload!
}

# --- subscriptions ---
type Subscription {
  productUpdated(productId: ID!): Product!
}
```

## Validation Rules

| Rule | Tool | Severity |
|------|------|----------|
| Valid GraphQL SDL syntax | `graphql-js validate` | error |
| All entities implement `Node` interface | custom `uptempo-gql-node` | error |
| List fields use Connection pattern | custom `uptempo-gql-relay` | warn |
| Mutations have `{Name}Input` and `{Name}Payload` | custom `uptempo-gql-mutation` | error |
| Payloads include `errors: [UserError!]!` | custom `uptempo-gql-errors` | error |
| Enum values are `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE` | custom `uptempo-gql-enum` | warn |
| No circular type references without interface break | custom `uptempo-gql-cycles` | error |
| Custom scalars are defined | custom `uptempo-gql-scalars` | warn |
| Subscriptions have filter arguments | custom `uptempo-gql-sub-filter` | warn |
| Header comment present | `_header_comment()` check | error |

Run validation:

```bash
npx graphql-schema-linter {workspace}/graphql/**/*.graphql
```

## Error Handling

| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| No entity types found in issue | Derive types from REST schema (api-architect output) if available, else generate `Item` placeholder |
| Circular type references | Break with Interface types, document resolution strategy in comments |
| Federation boundary ambiguous | Default to monolithic schema, add `# TODO: federation @key` markers |
| Missing field types | Infer: `*Id` → `ID!`, `*At` → `DateTime!`, `*Count` → `Int!`, `*Name` → `String!` |
| Subscription transport unclear | Default to WebSocket, add comment noting graphql-ws protocol |
| N+1 risk detected | Add `# @dataloader` annotation on relationship fields |
| graphql-js validate failure | Return errors from `validate()`, do not delete generated files |
| Workspace directory missing | Create `graphql/` directory tree automatically |
